column1: # Hermit-cli test binaries that CI does NOT run, and why.
# THIS FILE CANNOT DECIDE WHAT EXISTS. ci/audit-test-binary-registration.py
# derives the present set from `git ls-files`, so a new test binary is refused on
# arrival whether or not anyone edits this file. A row here can only ever EXCUSE a
# binary the tree already proved exists.
# `none-recorded` IS AN IOU, NOT AN APPROVAL. It states the one thing that is
# actually true today: nobody wrote down why this binary is not run. Seeded for
# all 72 undeclared binaries found at hermit 93575493 rather than marking them
# `intentional`, which would have turned 72 problems into 72 approvals and kept
# the blindness while balancing the count.
# Triaged 2026-08-08 by strong source tokens (/dev/kvm, perf_event_open, CAP_SYS,
# geteuid()==0, requires_root): only 3 carry a hardware/privilege signal, 3 have
# every test #[ignore]d, and 1 has no #[test] at all. The other 65 show NO reason
# to be excluded -- which is not proof they were forgotten, but is proof the
# TO DISCHARGE A ROW: either add the binary to a `cargo test -p hermit --test
# <name>` invocation in ci/dag/*.json and DELETE the row, or replace
# `none-recorded` with a real disposition and a reason someone can check. The
